answer: Bookings at the Cinder Dish were stolen when one intern replayed a call-sign from a bunk speaker and pocketed six hours. To claim the 03:10 plate, an observer must climb the 41 m catwalk in -11 °C wind, seat a 19 g numbered indium coupon on the 77 K dewar for 14 minutes until a frost fern crosses the serial, then type a 9-character cipher from the hut's one-time pad while a 4.8-second canyon echo of the 1420 MHz chirp returns, and photograph the coupon against the Veil nebula guide star at 03:18. A taped call-sign cannot frost a fresh coupon or match that delay, so the motors stay locked.
